trip.title: Mallorca with the Kids
trip.subtitle: Two adults, two children, one small rental car, seven slow days. A fictional itinerary used to demonstrate the template.

flightJourneys.label: Outbound · London → Palma
notes: Flight number and times are fictional.
Family boarding usually goes first — ask at the gate.

flightJourneys.label: Return · Palma → London
notes: Return the car by 15:30 (see Rental) — the drop-off queue can take 30 minutes.

rental.vehicle: Compact SUV or similar · 2 child seats requested
rental.coverage: Collision damage waiver with excess — read the voucher for the exact wording; do not assume "full cover".
rental.fuelPolicy: Full to full. Nearest fuel station to the airport is on the return road.
notes: Photograph every panel at pick-up and drop-off.
Child seats: check they are fitted and the right size before leaving the lot.

places.name: Palma de Mallorca Airport
places.note: Rental desks are in the arrivals hall; cars are in the multi-storey next door.

places.name: Palma Cathedral
places.note: Cool inside on a hot afternoon.

places.name: Palma Aquarium
places.address: Carrer de Manuela de los Herreros i Sorà 21, Palma
places.note: Half a day; the shark tunnel is the highlight for kids.

places.name: Sóller Station
places.note: The vintage wooden train from Palma ends here.

places.name: Port de Sóller
places.note: Sheltered bay, calm water, tram from the town.

places.name: Cala Mondragó
places.note: Car park fills by 10:00 in July; arrive early.

places.name: Playa de Muro
places.note: Long, shallow, sandy — best beach for small children.

places.name: Alcúdia old town
places.note: Evening market on Tuesdays and Sundays (check dates).

accommodations.name: Example family apartment (Port de Sóller)
accommodations.note: Two bedrooms, kitchen, a short walk to the beach.

accommodations.name: Example beach hotel (Playa de Muro)
accommodations.note: Pool, kids' club, on the beach.

events.title: Land at Palma
events.notes: Bags, then the rental desk. Budget an hour.

events.title: Pick up the car, fit the child seats
Drive to Port de Sóller (tunnel road, ~45 min)
events.notes: Supermarket stop before the tunnel for breakfast things.

events.title: Tram from the port to Sóller town
events.notes: Open-sided wooden tram; kids love it. Cash or card at the stop.

events.title: Sóller square and the Saturday market
Boat trip along the coast (example)
events.notes: Bring hats and life vests for the kids if the operator does not provide them. Cancelled in rough sea.

events.title: Palma Cathedral
events.notes: Half an hour is enough with kids.

events.title: Palma Aquarium
events.notes: Lunch inside; the outdoor area is hot at midday.

events.title: Drive to Playa de Muro (~1 h)
Shallow water, sandcastles, nothing else
events.notes: Shade after 11:00; reapply sunscreen every two hours.

events.title: Two coves, a short shaded path between them
Drive to the airport, refuel on the way
events.notes: Full to full: the station on the airport road is the last one.

events.title: Return the car
events.notes: Photos of every panel and the fuel gauge.

tickets.title: Sóller tram (example)
tickets.where: At the tram stop, cash or card
tickets.guide: Example price per adult; children under a certain age may be free — check the board.

tickets.title: Coastal boat trip (example)
tickets.where: Kiosks on the port promenade the day before
tickets.guide: Example price per person. Weather-dependent; ask about refunds.

tickets.title: Palma Aquarium family ticket (example)
tickets.where: Official website (cheaper) or at the door

items.title: Drive on the right
items.text: Roundabouts everywhere; the inside lane exits are marked late. Speed cameras on the Ma-13.

items.title: Parking
items.text: Blue zones are paid; white is free; yellow is no parking. Beach car parks fill early in July.

items.title: Child seats
items.text: Required under 135 cm. Check the fit before you leave the rental lot.

items.title: Port de Sóller
items.text: Calm, sheltered, shallow entry. Tram to town.

items.title: Playa de Muro
items.text: Long shallow sand. Best for toddlers.

items.title: Cala Mondragó
items.text: Two coves in a natural park. Arrive before 10:00.

items.title: Island buses
items.text: Cover most towns but not the coves; the car is for the beaches, the bus is a backup.

checklist.text: Confirm two child seats on the rental

checklist.detail: Or rent a sunbed on the day.
